events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Bastard's Love

options.text: We shall support you. May your marriage be blessed.
I cannot accept this. You will be married to another.

events.text: During the celebrations of his legitimization, [character] takes you aside and introduces [character]. "[character], I have no right to ask this, but I shall. I love [character], and she carries my child." [character] waves a hand at the party. "Before all this, I dreamed of a simple life with her. But now, I risk being married off to someone else. Please, my [title], allow us to be married."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Broken Crown

options.text: Energize your troops and generals.
Honor him with a heartfelt speech.
Keep the assassination a secret... for now.

events.text: Scouts report increased activity along the nation's borders. We soon learn why... [character], the ruler of [rival], has been assassinated by members of his own council. This news has yet to reach the public, so we still have a chance to use it to our advantage.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Capable Hand

options.text: Grant [character] full authority over administration.
Politely decline the assistance.

events.text: [character] assures you, there is one man who understands the politics of [rival] better than any other. [character] has been a close advisor to [character] for quite some time, and he swears there is no problem [character] cannot solve if given the power and resources.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Convert for Aten

options.text: Spend your time teaching [character] the ways of the sun god.
Give praise to Aten for his blessings.

events.text: Your zeal for Aten has not been diminished and persuade [character] to follow the ways of the one true giver of life, undoubtedly aided by your god’s illuminating rays.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: A Crowd of Admirers

options.text: I will take a moment to reflect on the glory of [rival], and my well earned respect as her leader.

events.text: You hold a successful court amidst a throng of admirers! The leading men and women of every [rival] Family come to pay homage. Entourage in tow, they all show their sincere respect for your rule. Bask in the glow of this glorious day!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Deadly Request

options.text: I would rather die than give in to your threats.
Fine, I will elevate the [family] to a place of power.
Disarming [character] will be easy.

events.text: Your attempt to influence [character] bears fruit, as an invitation to the grand [family] estate arrives, delivered by a comely young messenger. The Family greets you with embraces and a cup of wine, but soon the festivities turn dark. [character] and one of his cousins draw daggers and execute your two royal guards, leaving you unarmed and alone. "It is too late to buy our allegiance," spits [character]. "You will make room for us on the Council, or you will face the wrath of the [family]."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Dream From the Gods

options.text: A spirit of wisdom is trying to guide [character].
The gods of war are calling him to battle.
A god of love must be playing coy.
The king of the gods is withholding his true form to protect [character].

events.text: [character] has been spending each day teaching [character] the ways of the [rival] gods. Between learning their names and the rituals to appease each, [character] mind has been filled with little else. However, the gods are not only active during the day. The eager disciple confides in you that he has been visited each night by a divine figure wreathed in flames. Who could this divine visitor be?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Faith Divided

options.text: Agree to the demands of the [religion] faction.

events.text: [character] struggles to keep control of the High Synod as rebelling clamor to make themselves heard. The divisions in the faith run deeper than you knew, the religious leaders completely divided on the key rites that make up [religion] practice. The rebellious demand to be heard, proclaiming that [theology] is a core part of the [religion] worship. The brash faction claim that to deny the theology is an attack on, an attack that will be met with violence.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Fine Roast

options.text: Oh, no, I didn't mean it like that [character]! It's the height of flattery! Oh, sorry...

events.text: You cannot remember a finer evening. The food, the wine, the company... the delicious look on that bastard [character] face when you started joking about his height! Who knew he was so sensitive...

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: A Flower Out of the Dirt

options.text: Appoint [character] to the position of Minister right away. Spare no expense!
We've no place for him at this time.

events.text: Through many days of often exhausting court proceedings, you are repeatedly impressed with the intellect and charisma of [character]. He is a shining beacon of sincerity and genuine company among a throng of sycophants. His piercing insights into issues of high importance, combined with the undeniable charm of his eloquent delivery, have won over many members of the court, yourself included. Shall you make [character] an official Minister?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Gracious Welcome

options.text: Accept the welcome and do what you can from the palace.
Write and appeal to the Governor.
Order [character] to remove this meddling governor.

events.text: Upon reaching [city], [character] is surprised to be greeted in person by [character], the governor of the city. The Governor makes a point of insisting that [character] will stay as a special guest of the city, accompanied by dignitaries at all times. Such a watchful eye will make it difficult to set up a new agent network, with [character] reporting every movement back to [character].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Greater Calling Just Called

options.text: Can it really be such a bad life?

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: You do not refuse your King.

events.text: According to [character], being the chosen heir to the throne of [rival] would be an honor, of course... but he just has a lot to work on right now. In remote mountains, among the common people, or on a spiritual plane. he was a bit unclear, actually. But the upshot is staying well away from the throne and court politics.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Hero's Flight

options.text: We must keep a careful watch for [character].

events.text: From the moment we condemned [character], crowds in the capital have voice their displeasure, especially soldiers and members of the military. [character] has a strong following among the fighting men and women. When guards reach [character]'s estate, they discover that he has slipped away with members of his household. Now a fugitive, he will become an even greater foe.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Kind Gesture

options.text: If they are willing to play this game, then so am I.
Perhaps another time.

events.text: [character] visits the estate of the [family] family, bearing gifts. While they clearly understand the motivation behind such a gesture, they do not refuse it. In fact, [family] seem amenable to further endearments.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Little Advice

options.text: Alright, alright, fine.
I'm not going to pee on a bundle of barley, [character].

events.text: It took patience, experimentation, and the help of a good number of practiced individuals, but you got there in the end. An evening of such exquisite sensual perfection that the troubles of everyday life seem suddenly to belong to another person.... you do, perhaps, have some tiny regrets about inviting [character], though. She means well, she really does. "Darling, you really better check though, you never know when the heavens will a new child. Just a few minutes and a sheaf of barley, and then you can stop wondering about it."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Little More Time

options.text: Send your personal scribes and agents to assist the Spymaster.
Direct all local guards and army patrols to aid in the hunt.
Call off the hunt and scavenge what you can of the mission’s resources.

events.text: [character] has led his agents on the hunt for foreign agents in [city], tearing apart suspected hiding places and trailing suspected agents. Despite a number of leads, there has been no definitive evidence of an agent network. With resources for the mission running low, [character] requests more time and resources for his search.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Lost Friend

options.text: Of course I will. Go, be with his family.
You may not leave. I do not care that someone died, everyone dies!

events.text: [character] comes to you after a particularly hectic day, his face painted with pain and sorrow. "I am sorry, my [title], but I have not been able to speak with [character] on your behalf as you wished. I received news that one of my dearest friends has taken his life." [character] takes a ragged breath. "We grew up together... I know I have no right to ask this of you, but I must leave for the funeral. Would you handle my duties until I return?"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Man Without a Past

options.text: I will take what allies I can.
Such confidence is not always a positive sign.

events.text: Not a man of great public acclaim and standing, no. But [character] claims he can solve your problems, and a great many more besides.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Measured Voice

options.text: [character] is right, we must spare [character].
I must show resolve in the face of uncertainty, and he must be punished.

events.text: The decision is made. Guards have been sent to apprehend [character] and send him to the deepest dungeon. However, as you sit on the throne, unable to calm your thoughts, your husband [character] lingers by your side. "This act will only inflame the people's discontent," he explains. "They look to you for wisdom. Imprisoning such a measured voice will only confirm their fears."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Messy Affair

options.text: Comfort the [family] with a gift.
Launch a full investigation... but do nothing.
Make filthy jokes at [character]'s expense.
Mourn with all of [rival].

events.text: Late one evening, [character] is struck by an assassin's arrow and killed instantly. More notable than his murder is the method by which it was done. A rogue of diminutive stature crept inside the toilet and waited for [character] to heed his natural urges. The [family] family is furious about the affair, concerned more with the scandal of the toilet than with the actual murder.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Narrow Escape

options.text: Agent? What agent?
Set up a scapegoat to take the fall.
Instruct [character] to retreat as soon as he has set up a new network.

events.text: [character] barely makes it to [city]. For a week, your agent is hunted across the land after a loose-tongued merchant tips off the [rival] leaders about an agent heading for the city. This culminates in a desperate dash through a perimeter of guards placed around [city] in which [character] is struck by a guard’s arrow. He escapes capture by a hair’s breadth, limping into the city and disappearing into the crowds. A warning arrives soon after from [rival] saying that they will find and kill your agent.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Race of Pride

options.text: I will ride for you myself.
I am sure we can hire a skilled rider.
No, this is your own problem.

events.text: [character] stops by your balcony as you eat your morning breakfast. With a nervous flutter, he lands on the chair across from you. "I have a rather serious problem, my [title], and you are the only one who can save me." He pops a few slices of peeled citrus into his mouth and chews with a worried look. "See, I took a bet with [character] that my mare was faster than his monstrosity, but my rider has come down with the pox. I was wondering if you would be able to provide a replacement?" "Oh, I nearly forgot." He grabs another slice of fruit. "I tried to convince [character] of your character, but he was already so angry it made things rather worse I'm afraid..."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Royal Suspect

options.text: Take no chances and imprison the dignitary as a hostage.
It would be a shame if this dignitary went missing after leaving the city…
Tell [character] to stand down.

events.text: In his hunt for agents in [city], [character] has grown to suspect a visiting [rival] dignitary, a distant relative of the [title]. While [character] is pushing for this foreign noble to be imprisoned, [character] has sent diplomats with a strongly worded message that his dignitary travels with his protection and is not to be harmed. Are [character] suspicions worth the potential of straining relations with this foreign power?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Spouse's Honors

options.text: We could use an Overseer of the Fields.
I shall grant the title of Possessor of Veneration.
How does Steward of the Chamber sound?

events.text: Late one evening at court, [character] comes to speak with you in private. "You have chosen to legitimize [character]. This action places me in an unpleasant position and will be seen as a snub by members of the court. Please, grant me additional honors to show that you still care for me."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Stone of Fire

options.text: Leave the philosopher to his fate.
Encourage the sentence to be exile instead.
Recruit the philosopher to your court.

events.text: The High Synod has become embroiled in the case of [character], a philosopher and scientist known for investigations into natural phenomena such as eclipses and meteors. His findings even claim that the sun is a fiery incandescent stone, even larger than [rival]. The philosopher is charged with impiety, but has requested your intervention in the courts. Will you risk angering the [religion] leaders to help this scientific mind?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Viper in the Nest

options.text: Clearly, there are traitors in our midst.

events.text: Someone in the court must be working closely with [character], as he was learned of his jail sentence ahead of time and fled. We will muster a search party at once, but we can make no assurances of his speedy apprehension.

events.author: Solver
events.name: A War Declaration

options.text: We will offer gold from the treasury.
We can offer military aid.
Maybe another day.

events.text: The court wishes to gain the cooperation of the [rival] in a campaign against [rival]. They will require some... persuasion. What shall we offer?
events.triggerData: Ask a Nation to join your War against another Nation

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: A War Declaration

options.text: We will offer gold from the treasury.
We can offer military aid.
Maybe another day.

events.text: The court wishes to gain the cooperation of the [rival] in a campaign against [rival]. They will require some... persuasion. What shall we offer?
events.triggerData: Ask a Nation to Declare War on another Nation

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: A War Declaration

options.text: We will offer gold from the treasury.
We can offer military aid.
Maybe another day.

events.text: The court wishes to gain the cooperation of the [rival] in a campaign against the [tribe]. They will require some... persuasion. What shall we offer?
events.triggerData: Ask a Nation to Declare War on a Tribe

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: A War Declaration

options.text: We will offer gold from the treasury.
A tribute to the [tribe] is in order.
Maybe another day.

events.text: The court wishes to gain the cooperation of the [tribe] in a campaign against [rival]. They will require some... persuasion. What shall we offer?
events.triggerData: Ask a Tribe to Declare War on a Nation

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Warm Bed

options.text: Only I will decide who shares my bed.
He asks too much.
Promises are easy to make, if you never intend to keep them.

events.text: Nights without [character] have been lonely, even with the numerous servants you have asked to share your bed. It is not the same, and you pine for your estranged husband. One morning, he appears outside your chamber, asking for an audience. [character] wishes to mend your relationship, but only if you pledge to take no other lovers in your time together.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Way In

options.text: Tell him to proceed with caution.

events.text: While seeking ways to sow discord among the citizens of [city], [character] befriends a charming stranger in one of the city's many wine houses. This young man turns out to be [character], Heir to the [rival] throne. In addition to committing malicious acts to weaken the city, [character] has dedicated himself to turning [character] to our side.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Abuse and Ridicule

options.text: I have confidence that [character] will weather this storm.
Bring the Heir home from school at once.

events.text: Weeks pass, but you receive no response. Your appeals to [character] seem to have fallen on deaf ears. Until you hear the news... Instructors at [character]'s school have reported numerous attacks on the young Heir. Children of the [family] family appear to have targeted him for abuse and ridicule. The latest beating has left [character] unconscious and in the doctor's care. This time, the [family] have gone too far.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Accidents Happen

options.text: Send the [family] gifts to ease their sorrow.
Remove [character] from the court.

events.text: Workers on a [family] estate recently attempted to use an early model of a windlass in building construction. Sadly, the apparatus collapsed due to its faulty design. The disaster killed three servants and injured a distant [family] cousin. Members of the family have come to court, demanding reparations, or the removal of the great scientist [character], who first suggested they use the device.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Accused

options.text: There is nothing for it, I suppose. Leave them to their whispers.
Enough. A nest of vipers I can handle, or a court of the feebleminded. But Gods help any King when those are one and the same.

subjects: Former Leader And Parent Dead Us
events.text: Threatening [rival] future is not enough, it seems. Now [character] has taken to tearing up its past, digging up ancient rumors and falsehoods about the revered [character]. The worst of it, of course, is that much of the court believes it, that you are in fact but the illegitimate bastard of [character], having usurped the throne in a malignant plot. And what proof can be offered in the face of such groundless slander? Each retort is only yet more proof of deep conspiracy.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Acidic

options.text: There is only so much one can take.

events.text: As time rolled by, you had hoped life with [character] would settle into something more comfortable, maybe even pleasant. But his cold stares, acidic tongue, and mirthless sarcasm continue to make each day an ever more taxing gauntlet.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Acts of Charity

options.text: Encourage him to support charitable government policies.
Suggest that he continue working directly with the poor.

events.text: Once a week, [character] brings his young pupil to the slums of [city], where [character] feeds the poorest of the poor. The teacher insists that such a lesson is vital in shaping future leaders. [character] appears to be benefiting from this exposure.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Adopt State Religion?

options.text: Adopt [religion].
Not right now.

events.text: Worshippers from all over the nation arrive at court, seeking direction. Is it time to adopt [religion] as our State Religion? Doing so will increase Happiness in [religion] Cities and improve relations with families who follow [religion].

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Adopt State Religion?

options.text: Adopt [religion].
Not right now.

events.text: Worshippers from all over the nation arrive at court, seeking direction. Is it time to adopt [religion] as our State Religion? Doing so will increase Happiness in [religion] Cities and improve relations with families who follow [religion].

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Adroit Diplomacy

options.text: We will add [character] to Court.
Let us add [character] to the Court.
While we appreciate the gesture, your friendship is sufficient. We would not rob you of your own talent.

events.text: [character] is impressed by your recent attempts and interest in improving relations with the [tribe]. As a token of goodwill, he offers the services of either [character] or [character], two of the finest and most talented his tribe has to offer.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Affairs of Influence

options.text: Return the next night.
Ignore his advances.

events.text: [character] has remained elusive, but a chance finally arises when you are invited to a gathering of nobles at his country retreat. You are met by his husband, [character]. He seems very open to your company as the festivities begin, often sitting by you and laughing at your smallest remark. There is still no sign of [character]. As the other guests are engaged in a loud discussion, [character] leans over and whispers urgently in your ear, “I must admit that it was I who sent the message, [character] is not here. But I can deny my desire for you no longer. If you feel the same, meet me back here tomorrow night and we can finally be alone.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Bribe

options.text: Thank [character] and keep the money for yourself.
Offer the wealth to [character] if he is willing to join your court.
Let [character] keep it for protecting you against these schemes.

events.text: There are many tests of loyalty when serving under the rule of a [title], but [character] has passed this particular one. After being approached by the [rival] agent [character], offering a hefty bribe for starting an insurrection, [character] takes the payment and comes straight to you. Now both the gold and the fate of [character] are in your hands.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Agent Caught

options.text: Make an example of him to deter any other agents.
Recruit him to serve you and [rival].
Convince him to share the secrets of those who left him to rot.

events.text: [rival] is growing bold. Stealing into [city] during the night, their agent [character] attempted to sabotage the streets and bridges that keep the city running. Thankfully, [character] was caught before any serious harm was done. Now [rival] is denying any involvement, leaving their agent in your hands. What will you do with the would-be saboteur?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Discovered

options.text: Capture and kill him as soon as possible.
Send agents to follow [character] and discover the enemies' plans.
Have [character] make contact, pretending to be a traitor.

events.text: [character] approaches with a delicate matter. He has discovered an enemy agent, [character], in [city]. Your Spymaster [character] is visibly excited by the news, pacing back and forth and muttering plans to himself. There is a unique opportunity to turn the situation to your advantage, one not to be wasted! How will you deal with this unwanted guest?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Offer

options.text: Refuse to listen to the lies.
Execute [character] as a traitor.
Set both free, but let them know that you are watching every movement.

events.text: Your Spymaster brings news that a [rival] agent, [character], has been caught trying to instigate an insurrection in [city]. When you question him, the foreign agent is suprisingly open and offers to join you, quickly claiming that [character] has agreed to take a bribe to help the [rival]. Will you take action on [character] word?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Recognized

options.text: "Ah, this is my old family friend. We've not seen each other in years!"
Attempt to explain it away.
Own up to it immediately.

events.text: You have agreed to go hunting with [character] in an attempt to influence the [rival]. Preparing for the hunt, a face in his entourage of followers takes you by surprise. Your agent [character] clearly mirrors your own shock, and [character] notices the exchange before the two of you manage to regain composure. "I didn't tell my party who I was riding with today to confirm my suspicions, which appear to be correct. Why should I trust someone who would send agents into [rival] cities?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Secrets

options.text: See if your Spymaster [character] can learn the secrets of these devices.
Break the failed contraptions down for their components.
Send the devices with an ambassador to be returned to [rival].

events.text: Dark plumes of smoke rise from the [city] storehouses. Treachery is afoot! Within the stores, your guards find strange contraptions of metal, wood and oil. Fortuitously these devices, obviously intended to start fires, did not work as expected and only created an acrid, but harmless, smoke. Your guards at the gates report seeing [character] and his [rival] accomplices fleeing into the night.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: All Things

options.text: He is not ready. Devote your time to studying alone.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: Explain that you believe it comes from a unique connection with.
Discuss your new ideas together.

events.text: [character] has been helping you to learn about [religion], giving you an understanding of what is expected as a follower of the religion. You are studying together and discussing the theological tenets when you are struck by a sudden revelation and everything seems connected and whole to you, the matter of life clear and easy to grasp. [character] seems shaken and taken aback by your sudden reverence and fervor. He asks you to explain your revelation.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: All too Quick

options.text: Excellent.

events.text: With armies occupied abroad, [nation] is happy to sign a peace treaty covering a crucial flank.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Alliance Player Proposal

options.text: Yes.
No.

events.text: [rival] envoy arrives with a Alliance Player proposal. What do you say?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Alliance Proposal

options.text: Let us forge an alliance.
We are fine with peace.

events.text: A smiling [rival] messenger arrives at court. He expresses their pleasure at the ongoing peace with his people, and he proposes a true alliance. How do we respond?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Allies Above

options.text: Perhaps it is time to trust the old ways.
I'll... think about it.

events.text: [character] listens with sympathy to your political troubles, but opines that, sadly, his faith does not have the sway in [rival] it once did. But he assures you, "While I cannot help you, trust in the gods can. You need only seek their blessing."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Admirer

options.text: Well, don't you look delectable.
Ah, you must be the entertainment.

events.text: You knew that your soirees had been gaining a certain... reputation in [rival]. But the abrupt arrival one night of the [tribe] entourage, headed by a grinning [character], still comes as something of a shock.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Advance on a Retreat

options.text: As it so happens, I know just the spot to develop!
Nod wistfully.

events.text: [character] has dropped numerous hints about how lovely it would be to enjoy a summer retreat in the countryside of [city], if only there were a suitable place to host a relaxed meeting of the notables of [rival].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Embassy

options.text: Very well, let us secure peace.
No, [character] is too important here.

events.text: [character] has proved skillful in ingratiating himself with the [rival] court and ruler. So skillful, in fact, that [character] has requested [character]'s permanent assignment to the [rival] court, as a precondition of a peace agreement.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: An Exhausting Ordeal

options.text: I am so relieved to be done with this. At least I have learned something from the ordeal.

events.text: You called all of the leading families of [rival] to Hold Court in your Capital City of [city]. The proceedings are long and tiresome and you grow ever more wearied by the ordeal. The [family] and [family] Family have taken to court gossip out of boredom, and the [family] hardly ever even show up for this tedium. However, the Family Heads ultimately appreciate the effort to include them in court ceremonies, and the experience you've gained from the occasion is invaluable. Your reputation as a legitimate ruler who cares for his realm has improved.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: An Ivory Box

options.text: Such a grisly business.

events.text: A gift arrives at the court, a weighty wooden box decorated with ivory and smelling faintly of myrrh. Within it you find a severed head. At a second glance you recognize the man as an assassin regularly in the employ of [character]. There is a note tucked inside the box. It reads, "Your man was a good fighter, but I was better." Undoubtedly this was the work of [character], the man you sent the former owner of this head after.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ancient Lessons

options.text: The past is beyond us, and we must look to the future.
Clearly, these ancient peoples were inferior to us.
We must do all we can to learn from their mistakes.

events.text: One day, [character] and [character] take a tour of recently unearthed ruins with a learned scholar. They lay hands on ancient carvings, sketch the facade of a fallen temple, and explore the depths of an underground tomb. Dusty and exhausted, [character] attempts to impart the lesson of all this faded glory.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Angry Soldiers

options.text: I need to try again. The soldiers must trust me.
There is no more time for these speeches.

[character] demands that we pay a steep price for the lives of our agents. Some of our new scientific discoveries would be a place to start.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: First Temptation

options.text: I am convinced, [religion] is the better path.
Don't tempt me from the righteous path, [character]!

events.text: [character] finds you hard at work studying the religious practices of [religion]. Sidling next to you, he bids you to stop and asks why you are putting yourself through this. “[religion] is on the decline. [rival] needs a strong [religion] leader to see us into the future. Please consider carefully.” Is [character] right, or does your heart already belong to?

events.name: Flight from [rival]

options.text: They are dead to me. We must choose a new heir.
We will dispatch soldiers to find and recover the Heir.
[rival] will regret its meddling.

events.text: Far away in [rival], the relatives of [character] learn of your divorce before it happens. Somehow, word reaches your husband and he escapes the country, taking the young heir along with him. The disappearance of [character] flusters the court. They await your reaction.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fool of the Faith

options.text: Have [character] executed for his wayward teachings.
Cover for [character], but later remind him that he now owes you for this blunder.
Pass it off as a jest.

events.text: [character] has been invaluable in your attempts to learn the [religion] ways, explaining the right rituals, the daily practice, and introducing you to others of the faith. This culminates as he invites you to a gathering with [character], the head of the religion. You and [character] are getting along well when he asks for your thoughts on some of the core theology on the nature of the divine. You dutifully repeat what [character] taught. Silence. Both faces look back at you with shock and horror. “Where did you hear such vile and misguided ways?” [character] demands. What exactly has [character] been teaching you?

events.name: Fools and Madmen

options.text: Excellent, and much more entertaining than a spelling bee!

events.text: It is said that the Gods sometimes smile on fools and madmen. That certainly seems to be the case where you and [character] are concerned. The two of you share more than a touch of madness in common and can often be found shirking responsibility, drinking, howling at the moon and sometimes engaging in even more outrageous behavior. Recently, after a night spent getting more intoxicated than should have been humanly possible, you gave your own bodyguards the slip, made your way to the city streets and invented a new dance which the general public seems to quite enjoy. You've seen your citizens spontaneously break out into dance, emulating the steps you and [character] invented and everyone seems to be having a good time at it.

Bold or not though, on this occasion, fortune seemed more inclined to spit in [character] drink and kick his shins. The debts he now owes to you, personally, are of truly ludicrous proportions.

events.text: [character] and [character] stride into the hall. "My [title]," [character] solemnly intones, "[character] returns to you, a faithful servant of the crown and of." The court mutter in approval, many commenting that something seems different about your subject's disposition.

One of the guests jokingly asks what you had to pay to get [character]’s help. Payment hadn’t been discussed but perhaps it would be kind?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: From Afar

options.text: Well, I suppose we have more important matters closer to home.
[character] will regret this.

events.text: You begin to lose track of the seasons as you await a response to your demands from the distant land of [rival]. At long last, a tired, sodden, and very irritable diplomat arrives in [city]. The weary messenger hands a parchment to your aide before turning around, letting out a deep sigh, and setting back out on the long journey home. The letter bears the official seal of [character] and reads only as follows. “Come and fetch it!”

options.text: This agent has proven resourceful.

She has been serving him a constant stream of positive impressions of [rival] and your rule. If our relationship with the current [title] sours, we can hopefully rely on the favor of the heir.

events.name: Higher Expectations

options.text: I have seen the light! [religion] will become our State Religion.
Our initial gesture is sufficient for now.

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion] as a royal envoy, in recognition of their status. However, the [religion] council is hardly pleased at receiving some mere accolades, as they are far from satisfied with our current level of commitment to the faith. The High Synod of [religion] demands that [rival] shows its commitment to following the faith, lest we lose favor with them. Shall we adopt [religion] as our State Religion to placate the High Synod?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hired Killers

options.text: I shall dismiss these rumors with a speech.
It is important than we do not act rashly.
The court will root out all conspirators.

events.text: While surveying troops in the city of [city], [character] is set upon by a squad of armed soldiers and hacked to pieces. Apparently, someone paid these mercenaries to impersonate [rival] soldiers and infiltrate the camp with the purpose of assassinating [character]. Followers and friends of [character] suspect that [rival] may be to blame for the killing. How shall we address their theories?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hollow Rhetoric

options.text: I will not stand for such insubordination.
It is an officer's duty to question his orders.

requirements.label: Warrior / Brave / Valiant
tip: The leader must have one of: Warrior (a cognomen — an earned leader title); Brave (a cognomen — an earned leader title); Valiant (a cognomen — an earned leader title)

options.text: [character] must be reminded of my military experience.

events.text: Your series of inspiring speeches fall on deaf ears, as the soldiers of the [rival] army turn their backs on you at every stop. On your last visit to a military training ground, General [character] confronts you. You have heard that he is beloved by troops across the nation. "Hollow rhetoric means nothing to the fighting man," he says, as his soldiers look on. "You would be wise to remember that when the blood begins to spill."

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Holy Stone

options.text: We will finance repairs for the [religion] High Synod.
We have no stone to spare.

events.text: [character] has paid a visit to the venerable High Synod of [religion], offering our services and favor. The [religion] council is pleased that we have come to them, for they are in dire need of assistance. Their ancient temples and headquarters are crumbling, and badly in need of repairs. The [religion] elders expect us to supply the raw materials needed for the renovations in exchange for their blessings. With a generous donation of Stone we can placate the council. Shall we make such a donation to the [religion]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Homes for The Faithful

options.text: We will make a donation of building supplies to the [religion].
We have no wood to spare.

events.text: [character] has paid a visit to the venerable High Synod of [religion], offering our services and favor. The [religion] council is pleased that we have come to them, for indeed they are in need of assistance. Some of the faithful poor are living on the streets, and the [religion] elders expect us to support the struggling believers in exchange for their blessings. With a generous donation of Wood, they should be able to house the homeless. Shall we make such a donation to the [religion] poor?

events.name: Hostage Situation

options.text: Guards! Guards! Kill this assassin!
Attack [character] yourself.
Wait, we can talk this out.

events.text: As you enter your private chambers, a wild eyed [character] holds a knife to the throat of [character]. [character] bellows at you. "Not another step! I'll kill him!!" Sweat gleams on his forehead. "I know it was you. You tried to kill me!"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hunger in [city]

options.text: Hire additional physicians to treat those in [city].
Buy food from other nations to feed the hungry.
We will not take action.

events.text: Malnourishment in [city] has taken a tragic toll on the city's children, and leaders cry out for their king's mercy. Doctors are needed to treat the weak and ill, and food must be provided to feed starving families. We must take emergency action before this situation intensifies.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Husband and Manservant

options.text: My Love, he's perfect.
I've changed my mind. I only need you, my love!
No, I cannot accept this offer. The divorce is final.

events.text: [character] comes to you late one night, after receiving your request for a divorce. "Husband, I have not borne you an heir, but I still care for you. Please take my manservant, [character], and enjoy relations with him so that we might have an heir." How will you respond?

events.name: I Did What Now?

options.text: Uh, of course I did. Let [rival] quake before our righteous armies!
That's not- that can't... there has a been a misunderstanding.

events.text: You declared war on [rival]. Everyone agrees, last night during the party you absolutely insisted the messenger depart at once to inform the [rival] of their inferiority and impending defeat.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: If Stairs Could Kill

options.text: Scream.
Contemplate the agony in silence.

events.text: The morning after, you remember little, and awaken in a tangle of limbs. Not an unusual occurrence in recent days. This tangle, however, is somewhat different in nature. Such awakenings rarely occur at the foot of stairways, and, more to the point, usually consist of some tangled limbs other than your own.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In Heaven, as on Earth

options.text: Use this newfound fervor to recruit disciples.
Offer your aid to spread the city of God on earth.

events.text: The Synod has an invigorating effect on the [religion] religion. [character] rallies the church together with an impassioned speech, re-imagining the church and clergy as a city of God that is immune the rise and fall of earthly empires. As the Presbyters and Bishops return to their communities, there is a wave of new ideas and a fervor previously unseen in the faithful.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In Private

options.text: It is true, only one sits atop the throne.
[rival] is not ruled by one, but many.
[character] is not worthy of my time.

events.text: The mighty [character] leads a procession of [tribe] soldiers and servants through the streets of [city] to the court, where he requests an audience. "Let us speak together, as rulers," he says through a translator. "For it is only our words and deeds that decide the fates of these great nations."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In Remembrance

options.text: It is right to honor the great [family] rulers.
No, not unless all past rulers receive this honor.
A day for all past rulers of [rival] will be established.

events.text: [character] and other members of the [family] family wish to commemorate the great [character] with a national day of recognition. Unfortunately, this proposal strikes several other influential families as potentially problematic. Elevating [character] to a revered status only strengthens his legacy in the eyes of the [rival] people.
